response_id.description: CustomerThermometer-assigned response ID. Primary key; records with NULL or zero are dropped at source.

response_date.description: When the respondent clicked the survey. Cursor field for incremental syncs.

temperature_id.description: Numeric rating: 1 Gold, 2 Green, 3 Yellow, 4 Red.

recipient_email.description: End-customer email the survey was sent to.

custom_1.description: Free-form custom field 1 from the survey blast (`custom1` on sendEmail; CT admin UI configures the per-account meaning).

custom_2.description: Free-form custom field 2 from the survey blast.

custom_3.description: Free-form custom field 3 from the survey blast.

comment.description: Optional free-text comment the respondent added with their rating.

response_bounced.description: True if the survey email bounced. Excluded from CSAT downstream.

comment_hidden.description: True if a moderator hid the comment in the CT admin UI.
